oneOf.description: Only known commit produces Changed. sourceCurrent is a fresh observation of the ORIGINAL source after commit, not execution authority. requestClosed confirms only the exact access-choice wait consumed explicit Done; false never rolls back the already committed grants and must not trigger resend.
